title: User folder index, version 1
description: One readable index.yaml describing the direct children of an organized user-space folder. Keep descriptions concise, normally two or three sentences.

context.description: Two or three concise sentences explaining the folder's purpose.

name.description: One direct child name, never a path or traversal segment.

category.description: Human-readable purpose, such as outgoing invoice or incoming invoice.

context.description: Two or three concise sentences describing purpose and useful context.

reference.description: A non-secret, appropriately private source reference.

uncertainty.description: Unresolved origin, identity, currency, or processing limitations.
